name: Rance IX - Helman Kakumei -
source:
Once the most powerful and expansive nation on the continent, the Helman Empire is now a shadow of its former glory. With a military history stretching further back than any other, it has been brought to ruin by years of corrupt governance. Amidst the decay—and with whispers of civil unrest and potential invasions from neighboring nations growing louder by the day—a once-exiled man has risen to the challenge.

The crown prince, Patton Misnarge, who vanished years ago after a failed invasion meant to prove his worth, has returned. Now hardened by rigorous training, he is determined to reclaim his homeland. His audacious plan? To rally the peerless fighters he met during his travels and lead a small but elite force to revolutionize Helman. To perfect this daring strategy, Patton turns to an unlikely ally: [b]Rance[/b], the most formidable—and brutal—warrior of them all.

[b]Note from the developer[/b]: This standalone story can be enjoyed without playing the previous series, though familiarity with the Rance games will deepen the experience. For greater insight into the world and characters, consider playing [url=/v2047]Rance VI - Zeth Houkai -[/url], [url=/v487]Sengoku Rance[/url], [url=/v6985]Rance Quest[/url], and [url=/v14022]Rance 01 - Hikari o Motomete -[/url].

[Based on [url=http://mangagamer.org/rance/9/]MangaGamer[/url] and [url=https://www.alicesoft.com/rance9/story/index.html]official site]
translation:
赫尔曼帝国曾经是这片大陆上最强大、领土最广阔的国家，如今已是昔日辉煌的阴影。它的军事历史比任何其他国家都要悠久，但由于多年的腐败治理而被毁掉了。在衰败的背景下，随着内乱和邻国潜在入侵的传闻与日俱增，一名曾经流亡的男子勇敢地面对挑战。

王储巴顿·米斯纳尔奇（Patton Misnarge）多年前​​在一次旨在证明自己价值的入侵失败后失踪，现在又回来了。现在，经过严格的训练，他决心夺回自己的家园。他的大胆计划？集结他在旅途中遇到的无与伦比的战士，并领导一支规模虽小但精锐的部队来彻底改变赫尔曼。为了完善这一大胆的策略，巴顿转向了一个不太可能的盟友：[b]兰斯[/b]，他们中最强大、最残酷的战士。[b]开发商备注[/b]：即使不玩之前的系列，也可以享受这个独立的故事，不过熟悉兰斯游戏会加深体验。为了更深入地了解世界和角色，请考虑玩[url=/v2047]兰斯六世 - 泽斯崩坏 -[/url],[url=/v487]战国兰斯[/url],[url=/v6985]兰斯奎斯特[/url]，和[url=/v14022]兰斯01 - Hikari o Motomete -[/url]。

[基于[url=http://mangagamer.org/rance/9/]漫画玩家[/url]和[url=https://www.alicesoft.com/rance9/story/index.html]官方网站]
